name: Timetable
idea: Strong figures on a dark ground, tinted rows in place of lines and one bright lozenge for the thing to find, as a pocket timetable uses them to be read at a glance in a van.
gives_up: The look of paper that a supervisor trusts. A dark screen is also harder to read in full sun at the kerb, which is why it has a light mode

drawn_from.took: Open figures that read at a glance in dense tables, a tint in place of a line between rows, a rounded lozenge in one bright colour
A dark ground for a screen read in glances, a state shown as a mark and a word, no movement without cause

refuses: No lines between rows: a tint tells them apart
No colour but the one yellow and the four states
Nothing moves unless a value has changed

signature.what: A yellow lozenge marks where you are
signature.product: The current place in the navigation
signature.landing: The main action, and the band

signature.what: Every other row carries a tint, and no row a line
signature.landing: The table in the picture of the product

meanings.accent: the one thing to do next on a screen, and nothing else
meanings.info: not visited yet, or a note

colour.product_use: Yellow marks where you are and the one thing to do next. The four states have their own colours. The rest is light on navy
colour.landing_use: The same dark ground, with one full band of yellow

motion.product: A value that has changed is marked for a moment. Nothing else moves
motion.reduced: A changed value is marked without a transition

imagery.kind: Real screens of the product, on the dark ground
imagery.treatment: Shown whole and level, never cropped at an angle
imagery.never: Stock photographs, or drawings of people

voice.speaks_to: the crew or the supervisor, as "you"
voice.tone: Plain and exact, as one colleague to another
